nodes.docs: Crop the six faces out of a cube map, a horizontal cross in a 4x3 atlas. Each face is a quarter of the width and a third of the height, seen from the outside of the cube. The opposite of Cube Map Construct.
nodes.name: Cube Map Components

nodes.docs: Align six face graphics into one cube map, a horizontal cross in a 4x3 atlas. The layout matches the cube UVs, so the result can be used as a texture on a Cube node. All six graphics need the same resolution, each seen from the outside of the cube.
nodes.name: Cube Map Construct

nodes.docs: Unwrap a cube map, laid out as a horizontal cross in a 4x3 atlas, into an equirectangular graphic. Columns are left, front, right and back, rows are top, sides and bottom. The result is twice as wide as it is tall, with the north pole at the top and the front at the center.
nodes.name: Cube Map to Equirect

properties.info: Mirrors the mapping, for an environment map seen from inside the cube.
properties.name: Inside

nodes.docs: Rotate and mirror the content of an equirectangular graphic, keeping the resolution. The top is the north pole, the center is the front and the left and right edges meet at the back. The source is mirrored first and rotated second.

inLets.info: Mirrors the longitude, swapping east and west.
inLets.name: Mirror Horizontal

inLets.info: Mirrors the latitude, swapping the north and south poles.
inLets.name: Mirror Vertical

nodes.docs: Project an equirectangular graphic onto the six faces of a cube map, laid out as a horizontal cross in a 4x3 atlas. Columns are left, front, right and back, rows are top, sides and bottom. Each face is a square quarter of the width, keeping the width of the graphic. The graphic is expected to have a 2:1 aspect ratio, with the north pole at the top and the front at the center.
nodes.name: Equirect to Cube Map

properties.info: Mirrors the mapping, for an environment map seen from inside the cube.
